full_details: At the board from five you wiped the tables and wrote sit, ground, stories. You continued Saturday's half-sheet of the king come home to Wales, in two runs with a long halt between. Holinshed and Daniel lay open at the return from Ireland. You struck one long greeting and wrote it in one short line: his hand on the earth. At half past ten the book took candles at fourpence. At noon you rehearsed Egeon's roll. On the Bishopsgate post the Theatre's bill for Two Gentlemen stood beside the Rose's for Long Meg. From the tiring-house door, Kemp's Launce had a rope with nothing on the end of it. At seven Gilbert called from St Bride's. The wells in Henley Street are filled as the bailiff ordered. Anne's beans are a span high. Hamnet won twopence at the butts. You eat, and your mother would know it. Hobbins is in on Thursday, and you will fetch what Gilbert cannot leave the shop to fetch. You had forgot the girl's day. He had forgot it too, until the almanac. A year ago the middle of Stratford burned. You heard it nine days after, from a carter. You asked Anne whether the frame in Chapel Street is finished, and what the plasterer asked. Then you wrote thirty more lines under the short greeting.
one_sentence: You went on with Saturday's half-sheet, shortened a greeting, and Gilbert from St Bride's put the girl's day on the twenty-sixth.
title: Continued the half-sheet, and the girl's day is the twenty-sixth
